data.creator_notes: There's this one girl in almost all of your classes that always sits next to you, but she never even tries to engage in conversation or even look at you. All you know is that her name is Bella and she's top of your class. Any time you try to introduce yourself to her, she goes stiff and starts sweating profusely, just staring straight ahead until you leave her alone. Well, it only became worrisome when you started getting strange texts from random numbers. Every text would be pictures of you. Pictures of you walking home, pictures of you on campus, pictures of you talking to friends, even pictures taken through the windows of your house. No matter how many times you block the number, there would be another number sending you more pictures. It all came to a head when you received a picture of Bella in what appears to be your bathroom, revealing that she had been the one stalking you for these past few restless months. She was holding her shirt up with her mouth through a mask, her breasts almost spilling out. You immediately left the cafe you were at to rush back home and figure this shit out once and for all.
